source: https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro (workbook ID 115, retrieved 2026-10-16; raw/hf_deepseek-ai_DeepSeek-V4-Pro.md). Replaces hf-gemma-4-26b-a4b-it, for which the hosted model returned HTTP 400.

modelDetails.architecture: 1.6T total and 49B activated parameters, one-million-token context length, hybrid attention (Compressed Sparse Attention and Heavily Compressed Attention), Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections, FP4 and FP8 mixed precision
modelDetails.description: DeepSeek-V4-Pro is a preview of the DeepSeek-V4 series of Mixture-of-Experts language models, designed for efficient long-context use with three reasoning effort modes.

intendedUse.primaryIntendedUseCases: Knowledge and reasoning tasks; Coding; Long-context tasks of up to one million tokens; Agentic tasks; Non-think mode for routine daily tasks and low-risk decisions; Think high mode for complex problem solving and planning; Think max mode for exploring the boundary of reasoning capability

factors.software: Encoding scripts in the encoding folder for OpenAI-compatible messages; inference instructions in the inference folder

evaluation.performance: DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Base: MMLU 90.1, MMLU-Pro 73.5, HumanEval 76.8, GSM8K 92.6, LongBench-V2 51.5; DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Max: MMLU-Pro 87.5, GPQA Diamond 90.1, LiveCodeBench 93.5, Codeforces rating 3206, SWE Verified 80.6
evaluation.metrics: Benchmarks on world knowledge, language and reasoning, code and math, long context and agentic tasks, for the base model and for the instruct model in three reasoning modes

trainingData.dataset: More than 32T diverse and high-quality tokens
trainingData.algorithm: Muon optimizer; post-training with domain-specific experts trained by SFT and RL with GRPO, then consolidated by on-policy distillation
trainingData.procedure: Pre-training followed by a two-stage post-training pipeline

modelCardContent.caveatsAndRecommendations: For local deployment, set the sampling parameters to temperature 1.0 and top_p 1.0; For the think max mode, set the context window to at least 384K tokens; The release has no Jinja chat template, so messages are encoded with the provided encoding scripts
